$comment: Provider allowlist for scripts/shake-catalog.mjs (ghost issue #3, phase 1).
Upstream models.json ships 64 providers / ~4400 models (~9.2 MB) so that a
generic omp install can talk to anything. Ghost is sovereign and opinionated:
it keeps the providers a ghost can actually be bound to, and drops the rest.
Only providers listed under `providers` survive the shake. The file is a
per-provider record keyed by model id (see src/models.json.d.ts), so shaking
is purely subtractive at the top level -- every surviving row is byte-identical
to upstream and every consumer of `getBundledModels()` keeps its shape.
IMPORTANT -- local inference is NOT affected by this list. ollama, llama.cpp,
lm-studio, vllm and litellm are never bundled in models.json at all; they are
discovered at runtime by src/provider-models/openai-compat.ts against a local
endpoint. They are named below to record the intent (sovereignty means local
models keep working) and are reported as `absent` by the shake script.
To add a provider: put it in `providers`, note why in `rationale`, re-run

rationale.amazon-bedrock: referenced by packages/daemon/test/{auth,server-login}.test.ts and test/helpers/fake-login-runtime.ts as a login-provider fixture
rationale.anthropic: baseline; also anthropic/claude-{opus-4-6,sonnet-4-6,haiku-4-5} appear across packages/daemon and docs
rationale.openai: baseline; named in packages/daemon/src/models.ts and packages/shell/dev/mock-ghostd.mjs
rationale.openai-codex: baseline; openai-codex/gpt-5.* ids appear across packages/daemon and packages/shell
rationale.openrouter: baseline; ghost's default free-tier onboarding path (packages/daemon/src/models.ts, test/models.test.ts, test/server-login.test.ts)
rationale.xai: baseline; xai/grok-4-fast and xai/grok-code-fast-1 in packages/daemon/test/models.test.ts
